name: Petrol station at night
desc: A lit island on a dark road - somewhere to stop at 3am when the journey has gone wrong.
tags: petrol station forecourt, fuel pumps, illuminated canopy, fluorescent lights under the canopy, price sign on a pole, lit shop window with shelves, wet forecourt, painted lines on tarmac, moths around the lights, dark road beyond
prose: a petrol station forecourt at night, fuel pumps standing under a brightly lit canopy that throws hard light down onto wet tarmac, the shop window glowing behind and empty dark road past the price sign
note: The canopy is the whole point: a hard-lit island with blackness all round it. If the surrounding dark is not named as a thing - dark road beyond, unlit trees, empty highway - the model lights the entire scene evenly and the isolation is gone. Pumps render mangled at close range, so keep them mid-distance. Moths and the wet forecourt are two cheap tags that sell the hour on their own.
